panels.title: Battery 40 °C or hotter
panels.description: Charging should pause around 45 °C; above 40 °C wears the battery

panels.title: Battery data stale
panels.description: battery.prom not rewritten for 5 minutes, phone_battery_data_age_seconds over 5 minutes, or a node without battery metrics

targets.expr: count((time() - node_textfile_mtime_seconds{file=~".*/battery.prom"} > 300) or (phone_battery_data_age_seconds > 300) or (up{job="node-exporter"} unless on(instance) phone_battery_percent)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Below 60 % while plugged in
panels.description: The charge limit or the charger isn't working. Phones without phone_battery_plugged are assumed plugged in

targets.expr: count(phone_battery_percent < 60 unless on(instance) phone_battery_plugged == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: At 100 %
panels.description: A charge limit isn't applied, e.g. after a reboot

panels.title: Charge limit off
panels.description: The phone's charge-limit service isn't holding the battery between its limits

panels.title: Battery by phone
panels.description: Charge is estimated from voltage on phones with phone_battery_percent_estimated = 1. At the charge limit, not_charging, full or idle are normal

panels.title: CPU pressure
panels.description: Share of time at least one task waited for a CPU

panels.title: Memory pressure
panels.description: Time lost to reclaiming memory; rises before OOM kills

panels.title: Charge limit
panels.description: Charging starts below start and stops at stop

panels.title: Charge limit voltage
panels.description: For phones limited by voltage instead of percent

panels.title: Battery current
panels.description: ~0 while holding at the limit; negative while running from the battery

panels.title: Charger connected
panels.description: Empty for phones that can't report their charger
